about: Modern development set (60 messages, assistant-authored synthetic, 2026-10-26). It was written as a fresh validation set, but its first results were then used to diagnose the shipped-model failure and to add general warning-sign rules, so it is a development set now: it chooses thresholds and simulates a user's first reports. The untouched final check is fresh-validation.json. Labels are the author's, not independent annotations.
